label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: Shashi Prasad K closed the Marketplace platform review and next-sprint plan (MT-1600) on 12 Oct, and the sanity test of all 11 commerce journeys (MT-1598) and the RMA design review (MT-1593) were finished. Six new bugs came out of checkout and RMA testing, including tax values missing on the success page (MT-1605) and the subtotal showing the grand total (MT-1607), so open bugs rose from 4 to 10. Past-due items fell from 26 to 20, 14 of them untouched in 30 days.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Work on Raluca Conea's website feedback (MR-1341) started on 12 Oct: six animation, spacing and footer subtasks (MR-1342 to MR-1348) moved to Dev Testing, as did two High bugs on the Aerospace and Project Genesis pages (MR-1304, MR-1307). Kannan Elangovan raised five more page fixes for Events, GDPR and case studies (MR-1351 to MR-1355). 14 items are past due, the sitemap fix (MR-1199) is still Ready for Prod and 20 open bugs are unrated.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Livian Stefan Stan started the Go Live payments work on 12 Oct: the payment option stories (USP-4283, USP-4290) are deployed in Dev and four PAY subtasks are in progress, though their due dates of 7 to 8 Oct had already passed. The IAM and MSA permission bug (USP-4167) closed, and the updated NVIDIA, Supermicro and HPE servers reached UAT (USP-4251). Two S1 bugs remain open (USP-4231, USP-4204); 101 items are past due, 65 of them untouched in 30 days.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Dev environment integration (UC-228) started on 12 Oct, and a new High bug was raised: Book a Meeting wrongly triggers the customer support flow (UC-234). The booking-confirmation bug (UC-233) is still in development; sign-in (UC-225), the Teams handoff (UC-22) and model selection (UC-26) are due 15 Oct. 27 items are past due, 26 of them untouched since August.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: No change on the Pulse board. Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks now sit on the PRD board (outside this report's boards): 134 items, 10 of them raised on 12 Oct, with 11 in progress, 12 in review and due dates from 9 Oct to 25 Nov.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: No change on 12 Oct. The three items (ATLAS-1 to ATLAS-3) are in To Do with no due dates; the CRM MVP plan date is still not in Jira.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: The account deletion flow moved to Dev Testing on 12 Oct (ID-748 to ID-750), support reactivation (ID-751) and session clean-up (ID-744) moved to Dev, and end-to-end testing of MFA and profile updates (ID-759) started. A new production bug was raised: Klaviyo notifications are not working (ID-758). The 6 past-due claims-removal tasks (ID-679 to ID-684) are in production but not closed.

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change on 12 Oct. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: Configuring AKS pods as Azure DevOps build agents (IN-1128) started on 12 Oct, and Livian Stefan Stan requested a USP pipeline VM (IN-1152, due 31 Oct). 15 items still sit in BLOCKER status, most held by k.kishore, and 24 are past due; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: Shashi Prasad K started the marketing-site fixes on 12 Oct: the login 403 (DM-1088) and broken case-study images (DM-1084) are in progress and two link fixes (DM-1086, DM-1087) are in review. Two new items were raised: spam detected on all emails (DM-1089) and an HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect for portal links (DM-1090). Past-due items fell from 28 to 25, 22 of them untouched in 30 days.
